extraction.document_summary: Singlife Elite Term II is a term life insurance plan designed to leave a lump-sum inheritance when the Life Assured dies or is diagnosed with terminal illness. The base product has two marketed payment structures: (1) “Singlife Elite Term II (Regular Pay)”, where premiums are paid regularly throughout the coverage term, and (2) “Singlife Elite Term II (Limited Pay)”, where you choose a premium term (e.g., 5 years, 10 years, up to age 65, or up to age 75) and you get a return of value if you outlive the coverage term via a “Longevity Reward” and if you surrender early via a “Surrender Benefit”. For Limited Pay held to age 99, it states a payout of 100% of total premiums paid for the base plan; it also states Surrender Benefit can be 30% (during the 3rd policy year onward until end of premium term) or 80% (from end of premium term onwards), after amounts owing to the insurer.
quality_notes: Document provides clear product naming, base coverage mechanics (die/terminal illness lump sum), and Limited Pay-specific longevity and surrender mechanics.
Medical underwriting requirements, free-look, grace period, and exact entry/max ages are not explicitly stated (except renewal age limits in the GRO note).
Rider details are listed by name, but full benefit mechanics for each rider are not included in this brochure section.

policies.quick_summary: Term life insurance with lump-sum payout on death or terminal illness; offered with Regular Pay and Limited Pay premium structures. Limited Pay adds Longevity Reward (100% of total base premiums paid at age 99 if held to end of term) and Surrender Benefit (30% of total base premiums paid from the 3rd policy year until end of premium term; 80% thereafter). Coverage duration options include 5/10 years, yearly intervals from the 11th year until age 85, and cover to age 99; renewal is automatic for 5-year/10-year terms subject to renewal conditions stated for GRO/GRO note. Conversion option exists into endowment or whole life without further medical underwriting (subject to conditions stated).
coverage_scope: Death benefit (lump-sum) if the Life Assured dies during coverage term
Terminal illness benefit (lump-sum) if the Life Assured is diagnosed with terminal illness during coverage term
policies.coverage_term_description: Regular Pay: choose cover duration – 5 or 10 years; or from every one-year interval from the 11th year until age 85; or cover to age 99. Automatic renewal is stated for 5-year or 10-year coverage terms. Limited Pay: coverage to age 99 is stated.
policies.premium_payment_term_description: Regular Pay: pay premiums regularly throughout the coverage. Limited Pay: select preferred premium term (5 years, 10 years, up to age 65, up to age 75).
policies.renewal_basis: Automatic renewal is described for 5-year or 10-year coverage terms; renewal conditions are subject to a maximum renewal age of 89 and maximum expiry age of 99 per the GRO note.
policy_termination_events: Full surrender (Limited Pay) during allowed surrender window
Policy terminates after the premium term ends (example narrative for Limited Pay Premium Term) and ends at policy events described
important_caveats: Longevity Reward is only applicable to Singlife Elite Term II (Limited Pay) policies.

Surrender Benefit is only applicable to Singlife Elite Term II (Limited Pay) policies and amounts are based on total premiums paid for base plan (excluding rider premiums) with stated percentages by surrender timing; payment is less any amount owing to the insurer.
Premium illustrations shown are described as level but not guaranteed and may be adjusted based on future experience (in the example).

evidence.quote: You have the flexibility to surrender your policy from the third policy year and receive the Surrender Benefit7.
Surrender Benefit is only applicable to Singlife Elite Term II (Limited Pay) policies. For as long as premiums are paid up to date, we will pay:
a) 30% of Total Premiums Paid for base plan (i.e. excluding premiums for riders) upon full surrender on or after the start of the 3rd policy year till end of the premium term
b) 80% of Total Premiums Paid for base plan upon full surrender from end of premium term onwards.
The payment will less any amount owing to us.
You’ll get back your premiums should you outlive your policy term, and enjoy Surrender Benefit if you choose to end your coverage early.
